title: master-drift-velvet-ballistics: Amend master doc to drop `crates/velvet_ballistics` workspace member reference
description: Chore D-24. Master §23 (Workspace Structure) lists `crates/velvet_ballistics` as a workspace member. The directory does not exist on disk. The actual binary lives in `crates/vb_cli` with `[[bin]] name = 'velvet-ballistics'`. A stale `velvet_ballistics/.dolt/` directory exists at the workspace root. Master doc and code are out of sync. This bead: (1) edits master §23/§34 to remove the `crates/velvet_ballistics` line and add a one-line clarification that the binary lives in vb_cli; (2) removes the empty `velvet_ballistics/.dolt/` directory (or .gitkeeps it with a comment); (3) updates `crates/vb_cli/Cargo.toml:28-30` `[[bin]] name = 'velvet-ballistics'` reference to add a comment pointing at master §33.6.
